title: The Episode About Wazir Khan's Murder

blocks.text: Leading Singhs, especially Baaj Singh and Sham Singh, plead with Banda Singh to take direct command because they cannot sustain the fight without his visible presence among them.
They declare that they would rather die at his feet than flee and compare their situation to a ship trapped mid-stream, unable to advance or return without the captain.
The page shows how military leadership, personal devotion, and battlefield morale are fused around the figures of Baaj Singh and Sham Singh.
